pages.title: Electricity from Immortal Yuan
pages.text: The Xianeng Electricity Crystal always registers, even without another power mod. While burning, it produces 1,000 FE per tick and stores 800,000,000 FE by default; both values are server-configurable. It emits light level 15 only while running.

pages.title: A Three-Slot Screen
pages.text: Top-left is processing, bottom-left is fuel, and the middle is the extra slot. The large meter fills upward and shows amount/capacity on hover. The extra slot rejects manual insertion, never enters Xianqiao, and can be taken by the player or extracted from below only.

pages.title: Start the Crystal
pages.text: Horizontal faces accept True Yuan, Immortal Yuan, or a claimed Spirit Drive. Inside a personal Xianqiao, the realm owner takes priority; elsewhere, the drive owner is used. With no reliable owner the crystal still generates locally, but Xianqiao Output remains unavailable.

pages.title: Bind the Xianqiao Ledger
pages.text: Xianqiao Output needs a valid owner and stage-eight FE storage. The crystal first transfers and zeroes local FE, then its screen, capability, AE2, and RS all address that ledger. Above 800M the meter stays full. Disabling output only detaches it and restarts an empty local cache.

pages.title: Charging Comes First
pages.text: The top face feeds only the processing slot. Rechargeable items fill in place one at a time, then move to the extra slot; a whole stack runs continuously. Certus-like quartz takes 50 ticks per conversion. Each tick, charging may consume all available FE rather than the generation rate alone.

pages.title: With a Plugin Installed
pages.text: The extra slot may instead hold one reinforcement plugin. Production gains its multiplier; rechargeable items remain in the processing slot when full, and Certus-like recipes are disabled. Automation cannot extract the plugin through the bottom.

pages.title: Face Output
pages.text: Automatic Output controls active face pushes only. Every enabled face offers all available FE each tick, with no artificial transfer cap, while external pipes may read the same cache. Priority is processing charge, then faces, then Xianqiao. A bound ledger gives every access path one shared value, preventing duplication.

pages.title: One Rule Set, Three Crystals
pages.text: The green Mana and purple Source variants register only with their target mods. Structure, fuel, slots, plugins, and ownership are identical. See $(l:immortalstorage:compat/crystal_integrations)Crystal Integrations$(/l) for containers, Sparks, and Dominion Wand behaviour.
